info.name: Sleiman Koumaira - Services 2, 4, 8
info.description:
Postman requests for the services implemented by Sleiman Koumaira. Every route starts with /sleiman-koumaira.

Before running: start the service, run `python -m shared.dev_tokens`, and paste the four tokens into the collection variables (Variables tab).

item.name: Service 4 - Threat Intelligence (Sleiman Koumaira)
item.description: Threat Intelligence Service, implemented by Sleiman Koumaira. Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:5004/sleiman-koumaira

item.name: 1. Main requests
Sleiman Koumaira - Add Threat Indicator (IP Address)

request.description:
**Owner:** Sleiman Koumaira

**API:** Add Threat Indicator

**Purpose:** Adds a new cybersecurity threat indicator (malicious IP, suspicious domain, malware hash, signature or other indicator).

**Method:** POST  
**Endpoint:** `/sleiman-koumaira/threats`  
**Allowed roles:** Security Administrator

**Required parameters:** None in the URL. Header `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (token from login).

**Request body:** JSON, all fields required:
- `threat_type`: IP Address | Domain | File Hash | Malware Signature | Other Indicators
- `threat_value`: must match the type (valid IPv4/IPv6, valid domain, or MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256 hex hash)
- `description`: text, max 1000 characters
- `severity`: Low | Medium | High | Critical
- `source`: text, max 100 characters

**Success response:** 201 Created: `{"status": "success", "message": "Threat indicator added successfully", "data": {threat_id, threat_type, threat_value, description, severity, source, date_added}}`

**Possible error responses:** 400 validation failed (missing/invalid/unknown fields) | 401 missing, invalid or expired token | 403 role not allowed | 409 same threat type and value already stored

---
**This request:** Security Administrator adds a malicious IP address (High). The new ID is saved into the variable threat_id.  
**Expected status:** 201

item.name: Sleiman Koumaira - Retrieve All Threat Indicators

request.description:
**Owner:** Sleiman Koumaira

**API:** Retrieve All Threat Indicators

**Purpose:** Returns every stored threat with its information, severity, source and date added.

**Method:** GET  
**Endpoint:** `/sleiman-koumaira/threats`  
**Allowed roles:** Security Administrator, Security Analyst, Auditor

**Required parameters:** None. Header `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (token from login).

**Request body:** None.

**Success response:** 200 OK: `{"status": "success", "count": N, "data": [threat, ...]}` (empty list when there are no threats)

**Possible error responses:** 401 missing, invalid or expired token | 403 role not allowed

---
**This request:** Security Analyst lists every stored threat.  
**Expected status:** 200

item.name: Sleiman Koumaira - Retrieve Specific Threat Indicator

request.description:
**Owner:** Sleiman Koumaira

**API:** Retrieve Specific Threat Indicator

**Purpose:** Returns the complete information of one threat indicator.

**Method:** GET  
**Endpoint:** `/sleiman-koumaira/threats/{id}`  
**Allowed roles:** Security Administrator, Security Analyst, Auditor

**Required parameters:** `id` (path, integer): the threat ID. Header `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (token from login).

**Request body:** None.

**Success response:** 200 OK: `{"status": "success", "data": {threat}}`

**Possible error responses:** 401 missing, invalid or expired token | 403 role not allowed | 404 no threat with this ID

---
**This request:** Auditor reads one existing threat. Also used as the 'before' and 'after' evidence for the update.  
**Expected status:** 200

item.name: Sleiman Koumaira - Search Threat Indicators (by type)

request.description:
**Owner:** Sleiman Koumaira

**API:** Search Threat Indicators

**Purpose:** Searches threat records. All given criteria must match (AND).

**Method:** GET  
**Endpoint:** `/sleiman-koumaira/threats/search`  
**Allowed roles:** Security Administrator, Security Analyst, Auditor

**Required parameters:** Query parameters, at least one required:
- `threat_type` (exact): IP Address | Domain | File Hash | Malware Signature | Other Indicators
- `severity` (exact): Low | Medium | High | Critical
- `threat_value` (contains, ignores case)
- `source` (contains, ignores case)
Header `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (token from login).

**Request body:** None.

**Success response:** 200 OK: `{"status": "success", "count": N, "data": [matching threats]}`

**Possible error responses:** 400 no criteria, unknown parameter, or invalid type/severity | 401 missing, invalid or expired token | 403 role not allowed

---
**This request:** Exact match on threat type.  
**Expected status:** 200

item.name: Sleiman Koumaira - Update Threat Information

request.description:
**Owner:** Sleiman Koumaira

**API:** Update Threat Information

**Purpose:** Updates the description, severity and/or source of an existing threat.

**Method:** PUT  
**Endpoint:** `/sleiman-koumaira/threats/{id}`  
**Allowed roles:** Security Administrator

**Required parameters:** `id` (path, integer). Header `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (token from login).

**Request body:** JSON with one or more of:
- `description`: text, max 1000 characters
- `severity`: Low | Medium | High | Critical
- `source`: text, max 100 characters
`threat_type` and `threat_value` cannot be changed.

**Success response:** 200 OK: `{"status": "success", "message": "Threat information updated successfully", "data": {updated threat}}`

**Possible error responses:** 400 validation failed or field not updatable | 401 missing, invalid or expired token | 403 role not allowed | 404 no threat with this ID

---
**This request:** Changes severity High -> Critical, the description and the source. Run 'Retrieve Specific Threat Indicator' before and after.  
**Expected status:** 200

**Required parameters:** `id` (path, integer). Header `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (token from login).

**Success response:** 200 OK: `{"status": "success", "message": "Threat indicator {id} deleted successfully"}`

**Possible error responses:** 401 missing, invalid or expired token | 403 role not allowed | 404 no threat with this ID

---
**This request:** Security Administrator deletes the 'Other Indicators' entry.  
**Expected status:** 200
